technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions present but lack bullish confirmation; price trapped below all major moving averages with bearish trend structure and negative momentum indicators suggest this is a capitulation setup requiring additional confirmation before entry.

fundamental.summary: MET shows no fundamental momentum with zero insider activity, no institutional signal, absent government contracts, no lobbying presence, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 36 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (15/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but recent congressional selling by Ro Khanna ($50k-$100k) and mixed AAII sentiment (61% bearish) create conflicting signals with no recent news confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration with inverted yield curve, crisis VIX (335), rising dollar, and credit stress creates hostile environment for Financials; earnings in 36 days adds binary event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold conditions (RSI 9, Stochastic, Williams %R) combined with fear-zone sentiment (15/100) and contrarian buy signal create a classic capitulation setup with price near support at 54.067.
debate.key_bear_argument: Complete absence of bullish confirmation across momentum, trend structure, and fundamentals—combined with crisis macro conditions (VIX 335, inverted yield curve, credit stress), congressional insider selling, and binary earnings risk in 36 days—makes this a value trap rather than a reversal opportunity.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme oversold technicals (RSI 9, Stochastic, Williams %R) and fear-zone sentiment (15/100) create contrarian appeal at support. However, complete absence of bullish confirmation across momentum, trend structure, and fundamentals negates entry merit.
decision.primary_risk: Crisis macro environment (VIX 335, inverted yield curve, credit stress) combined with binary earnings event in 36 days creates uncompensated downside risk; congressional insider selling signals institutional weakness.
